title: Chapter 40 The Strength Increases Greatly, And The War Begins
content:
Chapter 40 The Strength Increases Greatly, And The War Begins

At the same time, the entire Xuan Gu Galaxy began to boil when the Eight Dao Systems appeared.

Countless spiritual energy of heaven and earth continued to gush out from the depths of the earth.

This powerful galaxy that had been silent for countless epochs finally woke up.

In the palace of the Lord of the Wilderness City.

"System, what is the highest cultivation level in the All Spirit Realm?"

Master Lu, who had been busy for most of the day, finally chose the easiest method.

Just ask about the universal system.

【Back to the host, the realm of destiny】

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng was a little dumbfounded.

He knew that the realm of destiny was very arrogant, but he didn't know that it turned out to be so arrogant.

Not only in this Hongmeng Universe.

He is invincible in the world of all spirits.

He originally planned to wait until the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm to upgrade to level 10, but now it seems that he doesn't need it anymore.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng lay down again, holding a wine jar in his arms, and began to fall asleep.

.........

In the outer city of the deserted city.

A store called Tianshan Ice Cream Shop suddenly became popular.

It is said that eating ice cream here is not only good for the body, but also practicing ice-based exercises will achieve twice the result with half the effort, which immediately attracted a long queue.

"Don't squeeze, line up, everyone has a share."

In the store, several young and tender girls shouted in front while collecting money, with smiles on their faces.

"Lord of the Palace, you are so wise. From now on, our Hanji Palace will make a fortune."

Hearing his compliments, Ye Hanshuang felt a little embarrassed.

The former top power Hanji Palace has now switched to sell ice cream, which is a bit ridiculous to think about it.

If the ancestors learned about it, I still don’t know how to teach her a lesson.

However, when Ye Hanshuang thought of the money she earned, she suddenly became excited.

Doing business in this deserted city is not a huge profit.

What's more, a popular product like her.

She could even imagine that she would be able to stand shoulder to shoulder with several big bosses in the outer city in the future.

And at this moment, a couple walked towards this place with a smile.

When everyone around him was shocked when they saw the couple, they quickly made way.

The two of them are the boss and the boss’s wife of Baihualou.

Ji Shengcai admires Tianyin.

"Boss Ji, what wind has blown you."

Seeing Ji Shengcai, Ye Hanshuang walked out in person.

Thousands of years ago, this was simply impossible. Now, even Ye Hanshuang, who is in the Heavenly Emperor realm, should greet Ji Shengcai politely.

This is the status of the boss of the Huangcheng City.

"Haha, I heard that a new ice cream shop was opened here, and I came here purely because I was famous. Unexpectedly, the owner of this shop turned out to be Senior Ye, whom I admired for a long time."

Seeing Ji Shengcai without any airs, Ye Hanshuang also admired Ji Shengcai quite a bit.

It is not unreasonable that the other party can do such a hot business.

Then Ye Hanshuang ordered someone to give Ji Shengcai a box of ice cream.

"Boss Ji, if you want to eat ice cream in the future, I will directly order someone to send it to Baihualou."

Ye Hanshuang said with a smile.

Upon hearing this, Ji Shengcai's smile became brighter and brighter.

But then, Ji Shengcai brought Ye Hanshuang aside.

"Senior Ye, I won't keep it a secret. Actually, I'm here this time to cooperate with you."

Ji Shengcai said, took out an ice cream and took a bite, his face immediately turned surprised.

"Wife, you taste it, it's so delicious!"

Mu Tianyin took the ice cream and took a bite, with a little surprise on his face.

"very nice."

On the side, Ye Hanshuang smiled.

"I don't know if Boss Ji wants to cooperate with me."

Ye Hanshuang was also a little surprised at this time.

Although my ice cream is so popular now, it can't stand a small shop. It will take some time to grow bigger. However, if there is a big industry like Baihualou, it will naturally have extremely high benefits, especially if it can make it famous. Fight.

"Senior Ye, I want to supply your ice cream in my Baihua Building. How about the money we earn? "

Hearing this, Ye Hanshuang smiled and said, "Boss Ji, who is three or seven?"

"Uh, then of course I am seven and you three."

Ji Shengcai said a little embarrassedly.

Hearing this, Ye Hanshuang shook her head decisively.

"Five or five points."

"What! How is this possible? Senior Ye, you can't do this."

50% off, buy the goods by yourself, sell one, and pay half of them, then how can it be? If Ji Shengcai hadn't seen the market for this ice cream, he would have left long ago.

However, Ye Hanshuang stopped talking.

On the side, Mu Tianyin's eyes turned around and then said, "Four and six points are our last bottom line, we are six, you are four."

"Okay! Deal."

Suddenly, Ye Hanshuang agreed directly.

Both parties have a sure profit and no loss in this cooperation.

In this way, Tianshan ice cream was also provided in Baihua Building, Huangcheng.

Imagine that eating an ice cream after you are passionate is more than a beautiful thing.

In the rest of the inner city, various new stores also appeared one after another.

The old man Zui also opened a shop selling liquor.

After Lu Daosheng, who was in the city lord's mansion, he directly sent someone to transform it into a bar.

From then on, this only bar in the entire wasteland city was completely popular under the promotion of the great city lord.

Time flies, and in a blink of an eye, the day of evil demons invading is approaching.

Inside the main hall of the city lord’s mansion.

Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand and the next moment, several figures flew out of the world in his palm.

It was Yunqi.

Seeing Lu Daosheng, everyone immediately said respectfully: "Subordinates, meet the Lord City Lord."

Above, Lu Daosheng looked at Yunqi and nodded: "Yes, they have all improved a lot."

At this moment, everyone's strength has improved a lot.

Ah Wei and An Xing directly crossed the realm of cause and effect and entered the realm of life and death.

And Yunqi was even more terrifying, reaching the terrifying realm of reincarnation above the realm of life and death.

Reincarnation.

Back then, the highest realm of the Hongmeng Universe ancestors who fought against the evil demons was the realm of reincarnation.

And at this moment, a terrifying breath suddenly rose from a place in the Tianxuan World.

This breath was exactly the same as Yunqi's breath at this moment.

Another powerful reincarnation!

Suddenly, all the practitioners in the entire Tianxuan World looked at that direction in shock.

"That's the Xuanwang Daotong!"

"It seems that someone has inherited the Xuanwang."

Hearing this, everyone looked at that place with envy.

Why can't that person be me?

In the main hall of the City Lord's Mansion.

Yunqi and the others smiled at each other, "It's Brother Gu."

They knew a long time ago that Gu Chen was called out by the City Lord in advance.

It turned out that there was such an opportunity.

Sure enough, the next moment, the space cracked, and a familiar figure slowly stepped out of it.

It was Gu Chen.

And Gu Chen also successfully broke through to the Samsara Realm, standing at the top of the Hongmeng Universe, looking down on the heroes.

"Subordinate, thank you, Lord City Lord! This love, I can't repay, I can only follow you for my whole life."

Gu Chen knelt on one knee and said to Lu Daosheng.

On the side, everyone did the same, and expressed their opinions to Lu Daosheng.

Seeing everyone like this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Then you have to do more in the battle, don't let me go out in person in the end."

There was a teasing tone in his words.

Everyone also laughed.

"Don't worry, City Lord. I have a long sword in my hand and a carved bow under my saddle. If one thousand come, one thousand will die. With me here, these evil demons can't enter the Hongmeng Universe."

"General Yunqi said it well!"

At this moment, Yunqi, who has broken through to the Samsara Realm, is extremely arrogant.

In his eyes, those evil demons have become chickens and dogs.

Looking at Yunqi like this, Lu Daosheng smiled helplessly.

You should know that the Xuan King of the Invincible Universe sacrificed in that war. If you look down on those evil demons, you will only suffer a great loss.

So Lu Daosheng still reminded: "Don't underestimate those evil demons. The world they live in is much stronger than the Hongmeng Universe."

Hearing this, everyone's face was a little surprised.

It seems that the City Lord knows something.

And at this moment, there was a sudden shock at the boundary of the universe.

Instantly, this shock spread throughout the Hongmeng Universe.

"Here it comes."

Everyone's expression suddenly became solemn.

Lu Daosheng looked through the endless starry sky and directly at the boundary of the universe.

I saw that the huge crack was torn bigger and bigger by the terrifying force.

Countless eerie and strange auras gushed out from the crack.

Then Lu Daosheng ordered: "All cultivators above the Heavenly Emperor Realm in the Wasteland City, go to the boundary of the universe."

Those with weak strength will only be cannon fodder if they go there.

They may not even be as good as cannon fodder.

"Yes, Lord City Lord."

Suddenly, the whole Wasteland City began to move.

No matter what countless masters were doing, they all put down their affairs and went to gather.

And in the void, a million-strong army was officially assembled.

In the army, the will to fight continued to surge.

It was the new army created by Yunqi, among which the 80,000 Lu family soldiers before were also among them. They were the elite among the elite, and the rest of them were also geniuses picked from all over the world.

In terms of equipment, they are even more inhumane. They wear top-grade armor and hold top-grade treasure-level weapons in their hands. They are almost armed to the teeth.

Looking at the entire Hongmeng Universe, there is no more elite army.

Soon, another force of hundreds of thousands of people came to the void.

The Wilderness Guard.

The leader is A Wei.

After so many years of development, the Wilderness Guard is getting stronger and stronger.

Moreover, A Wei has a shallow relationship with the city lord, and the benefits he has received are also enormous.

Each member of the Wilderness Guard wears special clothes and a long sword on his waist, showing a domineering aura.
